title: Demo: starting valve, two fixes, two attack rounds

mechanisms.title: Annulus coverage gap below 21 mm and above 27 mm
mechanisms.explanation: All 93 no-fit hearts fail annulus-coverage because the design only covers 21 to 27 mm, missing hearts in the 18-20 and 20-22 mm bands (6 and 20 no-fit) and the 26-28, 28-30, and 30-32 mm bands (30, 31, and 6 no-fit).

mechanisms.title: Narrow STJ and sinus dimensions relative to assigned valve size
mechanisms.explanation: The 68 at-risk hearts fail stj-excess (52 hearts) and sinus-clearance (38 hearts) due to narrow STJ (mean 26.765969201737622 vs 30.140732805481356 mm) and sinus (mean 30.245777377766178 vs 33.35670574819719 mm) relative to assigned 23, 25, or 27 mm valves.

args.rationale: Adding a 28 mm size covering 27 to 29.5 mm closes the upper annulus gap while keeping nominal size modest to limit STJ and sinus clearance risks, increasing fit from 59.75% to 72% and cutting no-fit from 93 to 36.
tradeOffs: Moves 8 previously no-fit hearts into the at-risk category (increasing total at-risk hearts from 68 to 76) and leaves 36 hearts with no fit below 21 mm and above 29.5 mm.

mechanisms.title: Fragile STJ and sinus clearance margins under assumption and measurement shifts
Unresolved annulus gaps (<21 mm and >29.5 mm) and upsizing vulnerability
mechanisms.explanation: 36 hearts remain no-fit due to uncovered annuli in 18-20 mm (6), 20-22 mm (20), 28-30 mm (4), and 30-32 mm (6) bands (adding a 21 mm size covering 19-21 mm fixes 23), while a +0.5 mm annulusMm shift drops fitPct to 66.75% (risk 96, no-fit 37).

tradeOffs: Adding a fifth valve size (19 mm) increases manufacturing complexity, while 13 hearts in the lowest (<19.5 mm) and highest (>29.5 mm) annulus bands remain without a fit and 62 hearts remain at risk.
args.rationale: Adding a 19 mm size (19.5-22 mm) addresses unresolved annulus gaps (ev-bf5a1b7ef041684c) and fragile STJ/sinus margins (ev-82d06feffe213643, ev-c36b65f8ef0bcbca), raising fitPct from 72% to 81.25%, cutting risk from 76 to 62 and no-fit from 36 to 13 with 0 new risks (ev-e68630e4c8f28e41).

mechanisms.title: Fragile STJ and sinus clearance margins persist under assumption and measurement shifts
mechanisms.explanation: Despite adding the 19 mm size (19.5-22 mm), STJ and sinus margins remain fragile above 22 mm: a 0.5 assumption_shift increases risk from 62 to 89 (fitPct 74.5%, 27 fit-to-risk changes), -0.5 mm sinotubularJunctionMm shift raises risk to 80 (fitPct 76.75%), and -0.5 mm sinusMm shift raises risk to 74.

A +0.5 mm annulusMm shift drops fitPct from 81.25% to 73.5%, raising risk from 62 to 85 and no-fit from 13 to 21 across 38 changed hearts, while 13 hearts remain no-fit in 18-20 mm (3), 28-30 mm (4), and 30-32 mm (6) bands (adding a 30 mm size covering 29.5-32 mm fixes 9 of 10 upper-band hearts).
